title: Panel Discussion: Lithium Supply, Strategy & Innovation: The Next Phase of Global Growth
gist: This is a member-only video page for a Benchmark Summit 2026 London lithium panel, 'The Next Phase of Global Growth', moderated by Benchmark head of prices Daisy Jennings-Gray with executives from Lithium Argentina, Albemarle, CleanTech Lithium and Galvanic Energy. The page gives only the panel's remit (supply growth, project development, market dynamics) and related sessions such as the Texas Smackover keynote and US critical-minerals financing.

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a lithium supply panel moderated by Benchmark head of prices Daisy Jennings-Gray, with Ignacio Celorrio (Lithium Argentina), Francesco Gattiglio (Albemarle), Steve Kesler (CleanTech Lithium) and Jeremy Humphers (Galvanic Energy). The panel covered supply growth, project development and evolving market dynamics.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray , Head of Prices , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Ignacio Celorrio , Executive Vice President , Lit
insights.so_what: The panel pairs an incumbent producer (Albemarle) with developers, which is a useful read on how producers and developers frame the supply outlook.
insights.quote: An overview of the lithium market outlook, including supply growth, project development, and evolving market dynamics.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Lithium Supply, Strategy & Innovation

insights.claim: The Benchmark Summit 2026 London lithium panel was titled 'The Next Phase of Global Growth', which frames the lithium market as entering a new expansion phase; the page gives no figures to support this.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray , Head of Prices , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Ignacio Celorrio , Executive Vice President , Lit
insights.so_what: An industry framing of renewed growth hints at producers expecting stronger demand or better pricing, but there is no data behind it here.

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a keynote billing the Texas Smackover as "America's Lithium Leviathan", which presents the Smackover brine as a major prospective source of US domestic lithium supply.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray , Head of Prices , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Ignacio Celorrio , Executive Vice President , Lit
insights.so_what: US brine lithium from the Smackover is being pitched as a large domestic supply source, which is worth tracking for North American lithium project developers.
insights.quote: The Texas Smackover: America's Lithium Leviathan

insights.claim: Benchmark Summit 2026 London had a fireside chat titled 'From Pilot Mountain to the Pentagon - Financing US Critical Minerals', which links US critical-minerals project financing to the defence establishment.
insights.speaker: Daisy Jennings-Gray , Head of Prices , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Ignacio Celorrio , Executive Vice President , Lit
insights.so_what: Defence-linked US funding is a financing channel for domestic critical-minerals projects to monitor.
insights.quote: From Pilot Mountain to the Pentagon - Financing US Critical Minerals
